kdav.cause: Debian 6.30 packaging made KIO a Build-Depends provider (kio6/libkf6kio-dev), creating a false KDAV→KIO build edge that KDE upstream 6.30 does not declare; KIO is intentionally a later Tier3 level.
kdav.remediation: Remove Debian-only kio6 and libkf6kio-dev Build-Depends; rematerialize as 6.30.0-0supralinux2.

kdav.note: Round1 removal of false KIO build providers validated by attempt2.

kiconthemes.cause: Debian 6.30 packaging added libkf6configwidgets-dev although KDE upstream KIconThemes 6.30 does not require KConfigWidgets; retained package closure also omitted KCoreAddons needed by the selected 6.30 KGuiAddons package. Debian rules additionally excluded two upstream tests.
kiconthemes.remediation: Remove false libkf6configwidgets-dev Build-Depends, restore the full upstream test set, include KCoreAddons in retained package closure, and rematerialize as 6.30.0-0supralinux2.

kiconthemes.cause: Full upstream tests now execute. kiconloader_unittest and kiconengine_unittest fail on SVG image loading/rendering; qt6-svg-dev is installed but Resolute qt6-svg-plugins is absent.
kiconthemes.remediation: Add qt6-svg-plugins <!nocheck> as test-environment provider, keep all upstream tests enabled, rematerialize as 6.30.0-0supralinux3.

kiconthemes.note: Round2 qt6-svg-plugins test-provider remediation validated by attempt3.

kjobwidgets.cause: Upstream BUILD_PYTHON_BINDINGS=ON reached ECMGeneratePythonBindings, which requires the Python 'build' module; Resolute provider python3-build was absent from Build-Depends.
kjobwidgets.remediation: Add python3-build as a Resolute build-tool provider and rematerialize as 6.30.0-0supralinux2.

kjobwidgets.cause: python -m build --wheel --no-isolation reached the configured backend but setuptools.build_meta was unavailable.
kjobwidgets.remediation: Add python3-setuptools in addition to python3-build, preserve BUILD_PYTHON_BINDINGS=ON, rematerialize as 6.30.0-0supralinux3.

kjobwidgets.cause: Build and 3/3 upstream tests succeeded, but dpkg-gensymbols introduced _ZSt19piecewise_construct@Base with the current Debian revision and Lintian rejected symbols-file-contains-current-version-with-debian-revision.
kjobwidgets.remediation: Add an explicit (optional) symbols-template entry at minimal upstream version 6.30.0, preserving the symbol as private/toolchain-dependent rather than KDE public ABI, then rematerialize as 6.30.0-0supralinux4.

krunner.cause: Two libstdc++ shared_ptr template implementation symbols were treated as mandatory by the Debian symbols template and disappeared on Resolute amd64. The Debian source also carried skip-flaky-test.patch, which QSKIP-suppressed an upstream test.
krunner.remediation: Mark only the two toolchain-dependent template implementation symbols optional=templinst while preserving arch=!riscv64, reverse/drop the QSKIP patch, and rematerialize as 6.30.0-0supralinux2.

krunner.note: Round1 symbols/test-patch remediation validated by attempt2.

kwallet.cause: Debian 6.30 packaging made libkf6doctools-dev mandatory although KDE upstream KWallet 6.30 uses a non-REQUIRED KF6DocTools lookup only for optional documentation.
kwallet.remediation: Remove the mandatory libkf6doctools-dev Build-Depends and rematerialize as 6.30.0-0supralinux2.

kwallet.cause: Build and tests succeeded, but kwallet6 packaging requires usr/share/man/man1/kwallet-query.1; without optional KDocTools that payload is not generated.
kwallet.remediation: Supply the PASS KDocTools 6.30 artifact as documentation provider, ensure libkf6doctools-dev Build-Depends without creating a Tier3 edge, rematerialize as 6.30.0-0supralinux3.

kwallet.cause: KDocTools support was injected, but libkf6doctools-dev 6.30 requires libkf6archive-dev >= 6.30 and KArchive was absent from the provider closure.
kwallet.remediation: Keep KWallet source at 6.30.0-0supralinux3 and add the already-PASS KArchive artifact only to the retained package-provider closure for KDocTools; do not create a new KDE KWallet dependency edge.

kwallet.cause: KArchive and KDocTools provider closure resolved, kwallet-query.1 was generated, dh_install passed, all 3 upstream tests passed and sbuild completed successfully; Lintian alone rejected _ZSt19piecewise_construct@Base because dpkg-gensymbols recorded the current Debian revision.
kwallet.remediation: Add an explicit (optional) libKF6WalletBackend.so.6 symbols-template entry at minimal upstream version 6.30.0, preserving it as private/toolchain-dependent rather than KDE public ABI, then rematerialize only KWallet as 6.30.0-0supralinux4.
